descriptions.zh:
通过我们卓越的生物工程、可观的投资和多年的辛勤劳动，我们在§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的盖亚播种计划取得了成果。

从今天起，§Y[Root.GetName]§!定会被视为星球中值得钦佩或羡慕的真正瑰宝。
descriptions.en:
Through our superior bio-engineering, considerable investments, and years of hard labor, our Gaia Seeding project on §Y[Root.GetName]§! has come to fruition.

From this day on, §Y[Root.GetName]§! must be considered a true gem among planets, to admire, or perhaps envy.

label.zh: 我们干的不错，是时候聚焦其他事务了。
label.en: We did well, time to focus elsewhere now.

descriptions.zh:
通过我们卓越的生物工程、可观的投资和多年的辛勤劳动，我们在§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!上的盖亚播种计划取得了成果。

从今天起，§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!定会被视为星球中值得钦佩或羡慕的真正瑰宝。
descriptions.en:
Through our superior bio-engineering, considerable investments, and years of hard labor, our Gaia Seeding project on §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§! has come to fruition.

From this day on, §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§! must be considered a true gem among planets, to admire, or perhaps envy. We are sure that our vassals appreciate our efforts.

descriptions.zh: 我们的宗主在§Y[from.from.planet.GetName]§!上完成了他们奇异的计划，将其转变成了一颗盖亚星球。承蒙照顾，我们现在可以让这座具有诗一般气候和画一般土地的天国派上用场。
descriptions.en: Our Overlord have completed their strange project on §Y[from.from.planet.GetName]§!, transforming it into a Gaia world. Thanks to them we can now put the idyllic climate and vast open spaces of this paradise to good use.

descriptions.zh: 我们的宗主在§Y[from.from.planet.GetName]§!上完成了他们奇怪的计划。这颗恒星被彻底摧毁了！他们用肮脏的平原和崎岖的高山覆盖了海洋。往日潮湿的大气也变得荒凉而干燥。更糟的是，他们对我们的困扰不屑一顾！宗主表示，他们让我们的星球“更加美丽”了。
descriptions.en: Our Overlord have completed their strange project on §Y[from.from.planet.GetName]§!. The planet is ruined! They have covered the oceans with plains and rolling hills. The once humid atmosphere has grown barren and dry. Even worse, when we voiced our concerns they were rejected out of hand! The Overlords say that they have made our world "prettier."
